rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Item dated 17 May 2000, 20:15, Moscow, Kremlin: at a meeting with 'Председателем Правительства Михаилом Касьяновым' on the structure and staffing of the new cabinet, the President handed him the Chairman of the Government's certificate; the item notes that the decree appointing him had been signed earlier that day (links decree No. 861).

bounded_scope: Chairman of the Government observations for CLAUDE-C01-19 only. Nomination, presentation at a sitting, parliamentary consent, approval or refusal, votes, appointment, the Government's resignation, dismissal or laying down of powers, continued duties, acting service and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
